acceptance.statement: Confirm the live command root is exact merge 894eb813c7cb5609ae517103a727d93ba8cbd1ed and supervisor lifecycle is running before sampling.
Remain a live supervisor-dispatched auto worker for at least 330 seconds without self-completing early.
Record UTC time, run ID, runner PID, provider child PID, heartbeat, supervisor PID, and task status at intervals no longer than 60 seconds.
Do not modify repository product files or .orchestrator/config.json.
Confirm provider-ineligible, cooldown-blocked, and failure-loop-blocked candidates do not priority-preempt the worker.
Handoff exact timestamps, elapsed time, PIDs, heartbeat samples, scan references, and any legitimate terminal event after at least 330 seconds.
